escalations: Engine surface T5/T9 will read: Engine(seed, instruments=None, scenario=None), attributes instruments, buffers: dict[str, RingBuffer], prices, tick_index (next bar's index, first bar is tick 0), scenario, activated_at, baseline, and methods tick(), activate(scenario) (stamps activated_at at the next tick index, appends nothing), deactivate() (returns to baseline, clears activated_at). Module function baseline_scenario() is exported for T5.

close is deliberately not rounded to Instrument.decimals: rounding to two decimals injects up to 5e-3 into every log return and would break the 1e-6 reconciliation. Rounding belongs at the display edge.
Macro drivers carry residual exactly 0.0 — they are the factor's own index, so an idiosyncratic term on one would be a factor move the factor did not make.
Synthetic per-tick volume grows with the size of the move (base rate drawn once per instrument from the engine's seeded PRNG), so an active scenario shifts the most-active ranking T8 needs for O11.
Counts are printed via the capsys.disabled() fixture, because pytest captures stdout on a passing test and the evidence command is fixed at -v with no -s. No conftest.py was added.
Orchestrator note: the first bar is at tick index 0, which is what T5's backfill must preserve for the Buffer boundaries refusal to stay unreachable.
